key_concepts: Solid, liquid, and gas are types of matter
Matter can change physical form when heated or cooled
Physical change is a change in one or more physical properties of matter
Melting, freezing, condensation, evaporation, deposition, and sublimation are processes th
Evaporation is a physical change from liquid to gas
Heat from the sun can change liquid water into gas or water vapor
Drying of wet clothes is an example of evaporation
Condensation is a physical change from gas to liquid
Cooling causes water vapor or gas to change back into liquid
Water droplets on a cold glass are an example of condensation
Dew on plant leaves is an example of condensation
In the water cycle, water from the sea rises as water vapor when heated by the sun
